name: saffron-menu
description: Digital restaurant menu: customer ordering app and admin panel (MERN).

scripts.install:all: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix client --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix client --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix client
